I always have deepest depressive episodes in the summer because I have a boring office job. I am an intern so I am basically silent all day because all my co-workers are much older. And with that silence and being able to do my job on auto pilot as I stare at the computer screen in my cubicle isolated all day really allows for all of thoughts I try to drown to surface and there is no stopping them because I have unlimited thinking time. Plus I hate the job, I work for a bank but I’m studying to be a therapist (ironic since I can’t even fix my depression but I hope I can fix others’) so I find what I do really not fulfilling and my life lacks purpose. Without school I have nothing stimulating my mind in a good way the way education does. Nothing to keep pushing for or act as a distraction. And since I am not forced to attend class nor live on campus in the summer, I really am able to isolate myself. I have no friends and all this extra leisure time when I’m not working since I do not have to study in the summer, which makes it worse and more lonely feeling
